audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid says 'Blooming Burst hits from outside your Tongue Lash arc' and whys[2] repeats 'Her Q poke hits from outside your Tongue Lash arc'. content.early says 'your Tongue Lash range matches hers'.
audit.why: Blooming Burst is 800. Tongue Lash is 900. Tahm Kench outranges her poke by 100 units. Tangle-Barbs is 1000 and outranges him by 100. The entry has the range relationship backwards on the one ability he can actually win the spacing war against, and it tells the player to give up a trade he is favoured in.
audit.corrected: You outrange Blooming Burst 900 to 800 — the poke war is winnable. Tangle-Barbs at 1000 is the ability that outranges you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is described as bouncing between targets: wants.you[1] 'hug a wall angle where her Tangle-Barbs E cannot bounce to secondary targets and chain-root you', content.mid 'Tangle-Barbs fired at a minion chain-bounces to you even when you stand back', content.late 'walls limit her E bounce angles'.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs does not bounce. It is a line that passes through everything it hits, and if it kills a unit or passes through a champion it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer. That inverts the advice: standing behind a minion wave she can kill through does not shield you, it hands her an empowered root. Wall angles are irrelevant to a line that penetrates.
audit.corrected: Tangle-Barbs passes through and grows. Do not line yourself up behind low minions — a tangle that kills one arrives bigger, faster and roots you longer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pop Blossom is treated as an unavoidable punish — whys[4] 'the AOE stun lands before you stack An Acquired Taste to 3' — with no mention of its tell.
audit.why: Pop Blossom has a preparation phase before the leap, and that preparation is hidden ONLY if Neeko is disguised. Undisguised, the wind-up is visible and is the cue to leave. Presenting it as unreactable teaches the player to never contest the level-6 window at all.
audit.corrected: The Pop Blossom prep is visible unless she is disguised — that wind-up, not the landing, is your cue to walk out.
sources: champ-data/_kits/neeko.json R Pop Blossom, P Inherent Glamour

audit.whatIsWrong: Shapesplitter is never mentioned in either layer, and neither is Inherent Glamour.
audit.why: Tongue Lash damages and slows 'the first unit hit', so anything she puts between you matters. Separately, immobilising crowd control breaks her disguise — a 3-stack Tongue Lash stun or an Abyssal Dive knockup strips Inherent Glamour, which is how you confirm a disguised Neeko rather than a real ally.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash stops on the first unit it hits, so check for a Shapesplitter clone before you throw. Immobilising CC breaks her disguise — your stun and your knockup both do it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/neeko.json P Inherent Glamour, W Shapesplitter

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues and no cooldown number appears anywhere in either layer, despite both layers repeating 'trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown'.
audit.why: The entire strategy is stated as waiting for a cooldown whose length is never given.
audit.corrected: Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range. Blooming Burst 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800. Shapesplitter 16s at rank 1. Pop Blossom 120/105/90s.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0], full tldr, winCon, report[1].t and report[5].t all teach 'the stun-into-Devour' / '3-stack Q stun + Devour' as one sequence.
audit.why: Tongue Lash on a three-stack target stuns and consumes the stacks; devouring an enemy champion requires three stacks. Against a champion who resets your stack progress with a root, spending them twice is not an option you have.
audit.corrected: Three stacks buys the Q-stun or the Devour, not both.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid says 'Your Abyssal Voyage at 6 gives you global utility but does nothing to solve the lane'.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage is the pre-rework ultimate and is not in the current kit. Level 6 gives Devour. The reposition is Abyssal Dive (W), from level 2, 21s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Level 6 gives Devour; Abyssal Dive has been the reposition since level 2.

audit.why: 50.80% over 374 games with a chart of Neeko 5 / Skill 2. Lane-losing and scaling-even is a defensible read for a dead-even number, content.late explicitly says 'the lane score stays EVEN', and the packet flagged no chart contradiction. Left alone — I did not want to invent a power shift to give Tahm Kench a stage.

edits.before: Neeko's E root at range lets her deny your 3-stack stun window entirely — if she roots you before you close the gap, your Q stun never lands.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs reaches 1000 against your 900, so she roots from outside your answer — and it is 12s at rank 1, which is the window you play for.

edits.before: Neeko's R (Pop Blossom) punishes any all-in you attempt: she leaps, stuns the area, and the burst often kills you before you reach 3 stacks on her.
edits.after: Pop Blossom punishes any all-in you attempt — but the leap has a preparation you can see and walk out of, unless she is disguised and it is hidden.

edits.before: Fish for 3 An Acquired Taste stacks by forcing her to react to your Q slow, then close for the stun-into-Devour before she can E root you
edits.after: Fish for 3 An Acquired Taste stacks with your Q slow, then spend them one way — the stun or the Devour — before Tangle-Barbs comes back

edits.before: Stand behind minions or hug a wall angle where her Tangle-Barbs E cannot bounce to secondary targets and chain-root you
edits.after: Stay off the minion line — Tangle-Barbs passes through and a tangle that kills a unit reaches you larger and roots for longer

edits.before: E root you at max range to reset your An Acquired Taste stack progress and deny the Q stun
edits.after: Root you from Tangle-Barbs' 1000 range, outside your 900, to reset your stack progress

edits.before: Tongue Lash range lets you slow her and contest the level-1 wave, and her Q poke is not yet bursty enough to threaten your Thick Skin grey health — genuinely even.
edits.after: Tongue Lash reaches 900 and Blooming Burst only 800, so you can contest the level-1 wave from outside her poke and let Thick Skin bank the rest — genuinely even.

edits.before: Her Q poke hits from outside your Tongue Lash arc and Tangle-Barbs keeps you from ever getting a clean 3-stack window — she farms freely while you bleed grey health.
edits.after: You outrange Blooming Burst by 100, but Tangle-Barbs outranges you by 100 and resets the stack window — the root, not the poke, is what keeps her farming freely.

edits.before: Pop Blossom at level 6 punishes any all-in attempt — the AOE stun lands before you stack An Acquired Taste to 3, and she has full burst available while you are locked.
edits.after: Pop Blossom punishes any all-in — but its preparation is only hidden while she is disguised, so an undisguised leap is a wind-up you can read and step out of.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 are her comfort window and your most dangerous stretch. She has no reason to ever come within Q range of you: Blooming Burst hits from outside your Tongue Lash arc, and Tangle-Barbs fired at a minion chain-bounces to you even when you stand back. At level 6 her Pop Blossom is a punish tool, not just a teamfight button — if you walk up to start your 3-stack sequence she can leap, stun you in place, and follow with Q plus E while you are locked down. Your Abyssal Voyage at 6 gives you global utility but does nothing to solve the lane; use it to affect other objectives rather than waste it on a Neeko who will simply root and burst you if you teleport onto her.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 are her comfort window, though the spacing is better than it looks: Blooming Burst is 800 and Tongue Lash is 900, so you win the pure poke war and should be contesting it rather than conceding CS. What you lose is the root war — Tangle-Barbs is 1000, and it passes through rather than bouncing, arriving bigger and rooting longer if it killed a minion on the way, so never queue yourself up behind a dying wave. At level 6 Pop Blossom punishes any walk-up, but its preparation is hidden only while she is disguised, so an open-field leap is a wind-up you can read. Your level 6 is Devour; Abyssal Dive has been your reposition since level 2, on 21 seconds.

edits.before: At 2 items your Heartsteel stacks and Sunfire Aegis aura make you genuinely difficult to burst in a single rotation, and now the matchup normalises — she is squishy enough that one successful Tongue Lash stun into Devour removes her from any teamfight entirely. The lane score stays EVEN because her pre-item lead rarely translates to a kill (Thick Skin keeps you alive), and your 2-item body keeps her from doing anything alone without her team. Play for flanks and river skirmishes where walls limit her E bounce angles; do not face-chase her in open terrain where she kites and pokes you down for free.
edits.after: At 2 items your Heartsteel stacks and Sunfire Aegis aura make you genuinely difficult to burst in a single rotation, and now the matchup normalises — she is squishy enough that three stacks spent on Devour removes her from a teamfight entirely. The lane score stays EVEN because her pre-item lead rarely translates to a kill (Thick Skin keeps you alive), and your 2-item body keeps her from doing anything alone. Play for flanks and river skirmishes where she has no minion line to empower Tangle-Barbs through; do not face-chase her in open terrain where she kites you for free.

edits.after: You outrange her poke 900 to 800 — three stacks buys a stun or a Devour. Tahm Kench wins the 12s Tangle-Barbs cooldown windows.

edits.after: Bank three stacks on the Tangle-Barbs cooldown, then pick the stun or the Devour. Tangle-Barbs is 1000 range and 12s at rank 1.

edits.after: Neeko wins by rooting you from 1000, resetting your stacks, and kiting you off the wave.

notes: The Tangle-Barbs 'bounce' description appears three times in this entry and is mechanically backwards in a way that produces harmful advice: the ability passes through targets and is EMPOWERED by killing a unit, so wants.you[1]'s instruction to stand behind minions puts the player in the worst possible spot. Worth grepping the wider file for 'bounce' applied to Tangle-Barbs in other champions' entries. The range inversion is the other one to check systematically — this entry twice claims Neeko's Q outranges Tongue Lash when it is 800 against 900. The champion-wide 'Abyssal Voyage' problem reported in tahmkench__mel.json affects content.mid here. One claim I left in place because I could not verify it: wants.foe[2] states Pop Blossom is a '1.25-second stun'; the kit file gives no stun duration, so I did not restate the number but did not remove it either. My Shapesplitter-clone edit note is Medium confidence — Tongue Lash hitting 'the first unit hit' is from Tahm Kench's own kit text, but whether Neeko's clone counts as a blocking unit is not derivable from either file, so I raised it only in the audit and did not build a lane instruction on it. No WKM_LINES errors observed for this matchup.
